intro: Mauritius is one of those places that stays with you long after the trip ends. Lagoons, mountains and a familiar Indian touch — and it is easier to plan than you might think.

sections.heading: Why visit Mauritius
paragraphs: Mauritius (Indian Ocean) is known for its beach, island and romantic experiences. Overall it is on the premium side — worth saving up for, though budget options exist.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is May to December.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Direct flights from Mumbai and other Indian cities.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Rent a car — the island is easy to drive and distances are short.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Mauritius?

faq.a: Direct flights from Mumbai and other Indian cities.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Mauritius?
faq.a: Popular choices: North for nightlife (Grand Baie); East for beaches; South-west for Le Morne.
